PROCEDURE filter_and_populate (rg_name varchar2,
 rg_id RecordGroup)IS

 id_data_rg RecordGroup;
 id_gc Groupcolumn;
 nCurrRec number := 0;
 nCredits number := 0;

 nTotalRecords number := 0;
 szDonorID varchar2(10) := '';
 szDonorName varchar2(100) := '';
 szDOB varchar2(15) := '';
 szABO_DESC varchar2(50) := ''; 
 szGender VARCHAR2(1);
 szDonorAddress varchar2(200) := '';
 nUnits number := 0;
 szLastDonationDate varchar2(10) := '';
 szLastUnitID varchar2(15) := '';
 szHomePhoneNo varchar2(25) := '';
 szDayPhoneNo varchar2(25) := '';
 bShowThisRecord Boolean := TRUE;
 nCount number := 0;
 nGallons number := 0;
 szday varchar2(3) := '';
 p_chap_id varchar2(4);
 
BEGIN
 nTotalRecords := get_group_row_count(rg_id);
 message('Retrieving information.......', no_acknowledge);
 --pitss synchronize;
 id_data_rg := find_group('DATA_RECS');
 if not id_null(id_data_rg) then
 delete_group(id_data_rg);
 end if;

 id_data_rg := create_group('DATA_RECS');
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_ID' , CHAR_COLUMN, 10);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_NAME' , CHAR_COLUMN, 100);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_DOB' , DATE_COLUMN);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DOB_DAY' , CHAR_COLUMN, 3);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_GENDER' , CHAR_COLUMN, 1);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_ABO' , CHAR_COLUMN, 10);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_DONS' , NUMBER_COLUMN);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_CREDITS' , NUMBER_COLUMN);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_GALS' , NUMBER_COLUMN);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_LAST_DON' , DATE_COLUMN);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_LAST_UNIT', CHAR_COLUMN, 15);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_HOME' , CHAR_COLUMN, 25);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_WORK' , CHAR_COLUMN, 25);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_data_rg, 'DONOR_ADDRESS' , CHAR_COLUMN, 200);

 for i in 1 .. nTotalRecords
 loop
 szDonorID := get_group_char_cell(rg_name || '.donor_id', i);
 bShowThisRecord := TRUE;
 nUnits := DON_STD.DONOR_LIFE_UNIT_COUNT(szdonorID, :global.chapter_id);
 nCredits := DON_STD.DONOR_LIFE_CREDIT_COUNT(szdonorID, :global.chapter_id);
 nGallons := DON_STD.DONOR_LIFE_GALLON_COUNT(szdonorID, :global.chapter_id);
 if :ctrl_block.search_type = 'Units' then
 -- number of units (claimed donations are not counted)
 if to_number(:ctrl_block.code) < nUnits then
 bShowThisRecord := FALSE;
 end if;

 elsif :ctrl_block.search_type = 'GallonDonors' then
 -- number of gallons
 if to_number(:ctrl_block.code) < floor(nCredits/8) then
 bShowThisRecord := FALSE;
 end if;

 elsif :ctrl_block.search_type = 'Credits' then
 -- number of credits
 if to_number(:ctrl_block.code) < nCredits then
 bShowThisRecord := FALSE;
 end if;

 elsif :ctrl_block.search_type = 'FirstTimeFixed' then
 -- check number of donations between a given date range
 nCount := don_std.donor_life_unit_count(szDonorID,
 :global.chapter_id);
 if nCount != 1 then
 bShowThisRecord := FALSE;
 end if;
 end if;

 If is_multi_chapter then 
 p_chap_id:='ALL';
 Else
 p_chap_id:=:GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 End If;
 
 if bShowThisRecord then
 szDonorName := DON_STD.DONOR_NAME(szdonorID, p_chap_id);
 szDOB := to_char(DON_STD.DONOR_DOB (szdonorID, p_chap_id), 'MM-DD-YYYY');
 szGender := DON_STD.DONOR_SEX(szdonorID, p_chap_id);
 szABO_DESC := DON_STD.DONOR_ABO(szdonorID, p_chap_id);
 szDonorAddress := DON_STD.DONOR_ADDRESS(szdonorID, p_chap_id);
 szHomePhoneNo := DON_STD.DONOR_HOME_PHONE(szdonorID, p_chap_id);
 szDayPhoneNo := DON_STD.DONOR_WORK_PHONE(szdonorID, p_chap_id);

 szLastDonationDate := to_char(DON_STD.LAST_DONATION_DATE(szdonorID, :global.chapter_id),
 'MM-DD-YYYY');
 szLastUnitID := DON_STD.LAST_DONATION_UNIT_ID(szdonorID, :global.chapter_id);
 szday := to_char(DON_STD.DONOR_DOB (szdonorID, p_chap_id), 'DY');
 add_group_row(id_data_rg, END_OF_GROUP);
 nCurrRec := get_group_row_count(id_data_rg);
 set_group_char_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_ID' , nCurrRec, szDonorID);
 set_group_char_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_NAME' , nCurrRec, szDonorName);
 set_group_date_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_DOB' , nCurrRec, to_date(szDOB, 'MM-DD-YYYY'));
 set_group_char_cell ('DATA_RECS.DOB_DAY' , nCurrRec, szday);
 set_group_char_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_GENDER' , nCurrRec, szGender);
 set_group_char_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_ABO' , nCurrRec, szABO_DESC);
 set_group_number_cell('DATA_RECS.DONOR_DONS' , nCurrRec, nUnits);
 set_group_number_cell('DATA_RECS.DONOR_CREDITS' , nCurrRec, nCredits);
 set_group_number_cell('DATA_RECS.DONOR_GALS' , nCurrRec, floor(nCredits / 8));
 set_group_date_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_LAST_DON' , nCurrRec, to_date(szLastDonationDate, 'MM-DD-YYYY'));
 set_group_char_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_LAST_UNIT', nCurrRec, szLastUnitID);
 set_group_char_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_HOME' , nCurrRec, szHomePhoneNo);
 set_group_char_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_WORK' , nCurrRec, szDayPhoneNo);
 set_group_char_cell ('DATA_RECS.DONOR_ADDRESS' , nCurrRec, szDonorAddress);
 end if;
 clear_message;
 message('Retrieving information.......' ||
 to_char(round(i/nTotalRecords *100)) || '%', no_acknowledge);
 --pitss synchronize;
 end loop;

 --pitss synchronize;
 sort_data ('DATA_RECS', id_data_rg);
END;

declare
 v_local_date date; 
begin
 /* IM 5700 Issue with end date*/
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_date);
 ELSE
 v_local_date := SYSDATE;
 END IF;
 
 check_package_failure;
 if :ctrl_block.end_date is null and 
 :system.trigger_item = 'CTRL_BLOCK.END_DATE' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve', enabled, property_false);
 show_error('11067');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.search_type != 'Action' then
 --if :ctrl_block.start_date > trunc( sysdate ) then --IM5700
 if :ctrl_block.start_date > trunc( v_local_date ) then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve', enabled, property_false);
 show_error('18014');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 --if :ctrl_block.end_date > trunc( sysdate ) then -- IM5700
 if :ctrl_block.end_date > trunc( v_local_date ) then 
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve', enabled, property_false);
 show_error('18014');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.end_date is not null then
 if :ctrl_block.start_date > :ctrl_block.end_date then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve', enabled, property_false);
 show_error('11065');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.start_date is not null and 
 :ctrl_block.end_date is not null then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve', enabled, property_true);
 end if;

exception
 when value_error then
 show_error('9191');
 raise form_trigger_failure;

end;
